current_task_corrections.correction: Add join_check component step to the plan with pairs parameter set to ['medical_claims.rendering_npi->providers.provider_npi'] to verify the join cardinality and detect any unmatched keys before using provider attributes.
Set write_report parameter show_denominators to true to print every rate as numerator / denominator = rate, making the statistical foundation of each metric transparent.
Add 'small_groups' to the write_report parameter caveats list to communicate that rates computed for small groups are statistically unstable.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When reporting rates in analyses, display denominators alongside every rate (as numerator / denominator = rate) to make the statistical foundation and sample size transparent to stakeholders.
When computing group-level statistics, include the small_groups caveat to signal that rates for groups below a size threshold are statistically unstable and should be interpreted with caution.
